identity.summary: Real Singapore company, HQ 2 Changi North Street 1; formerly SGX-listed (JLB), acquired and delisted by Aalberts N.V. late 2025. Founding year not found.
identity.how_openserp_helped: Search returned SGX filing, Aalberts release, MCF profile directly.

business_and_headcount.summary: Precision machining, sheet metal, mechatronics, assembly/test for semicon, life sciences, medical, aerospace. Six facilities in Singapore, Malaysia (Penang), China (Suzhou). About 1,800 employees (per acquirer, 2025).
business_and_headcount.how_openserp_helped: Extract of acquirer release gave clear headcount.

financial_performance.summary: 2024 revenue SGD 160m, adj EBITDA margin 19% (Aalberts). 1H2025 revenue S$94.2m (+37.9%), profit S$3.15m (-26.8%, FX losses and corporate expenses). Acquired at S$0.94/share, 11.9% premium.
financial_performance.how_openserp_helped: Multiple independent news and filing sources.
financial_performance.what_was_missing: Post-acquisition results (now private); full-year FY2025 figures.

layoffs_restructuring.summary: No layoffs found via OpenSERP; absence is not proof. The acquisition is a restructuring-relevant event; no integration plans found.
layoffs_restructuring.how_openserp_helped: Targeted queries returned acquisition news only.

culture_and_sentiment.summary: Indeed: 3.1/5 from 9 reviews; sub-ratings 2.6-2.7 for management, pay, job security, culture; reviews mostly 2019-2023. Complaints on people management and overtime; some praise for learning lean/5S. Jobstreet profile snippet mentions fair pay and good increments. Glassdoor extract failed.
culture_and_sentiment.what_was_missing: Recent reviews (2024-2026), Glassdoor content, turnover data.

pay_and_benefits.summary: No salary figures or benefits list found; only qualitative remarks from review sites.
pay_and_benefits.how_openserp_helped: Found a current Production Engineer posting.

interview_and_hiring.summary: Only job-posting content: Production Engineer (Precision Engineering), East Region, 3-5 yrs, Mazak machining centre ownership, fixture design, CI/Six Sigma, ERP analysis. No interview process info.

red_flags_and_scams.summary: No scam, lawsuit or regulatory complaint surfaced in one targeted search.
red_flags_and_scams.what_was_missing: Court/MOM records; absence cannot be verified.

recent_news.summary: Aalberts agreed to acquire GVT 10 Jul 2025, completed 31 Oct 2025, consolidated from 1 Nov 2025; delisting expected around 4 Nov 2025.

misleading_or_wrong_results: Broad layoffs query returned generic layoff trackers unrelated to GVT
Company name variants (Pte Ltd, Private Limited, Limited) across sites

verdict.reasoning: Strong for identity, financials and news; weak on pay, interview process and current culture. One duckduckgo timeout, one 32s search.
what_else_a_job_seeker_would_need: offer terms on overtime and shifts
